title: Show the recorded case-file state on Agora meeting memos

incident.defect: DeliberativeMeetingDetail in src/agora/pages/learning/CommitteePage.tsx loaded memos via GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/{meetingId}/memos and rendered dissent-memo-{memo_id} rows with id, status, summary, and recommendation, but omitted the CaseFileViewPanel binding that gate-panel Memos rendered.

owned_layer: Frontend deliberative meeting and gate-panel memo case-file rendering in src/agora/pages/learning/CommitteePage.tsx and unavailable title labeling in src/management/components/case-file/CaseFileViewPanel.tsx
not_changing: BFF routes and owners (uses existing GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/{id}/memos and existing CaseFileViewPanel)
Locale dictionary files (reuses existing zh-TW and en-US caseFile.* strings: 決策卷宗, 無法讀取, 未記錄原因)
No synthetic case-file items, memos, or memories

changes.src/agora/pages/learning/CommitteePage.t: Bound CaseFileViewPanel (view={m.case_file_view}, scope={`memo-${m.memo_id}`}, testId={`memo-${m.memo_id}-case-file`}) inside each deliberative meeting memo row (dissent-memo-${m.memo_id}) in DeliberativeMeetingDetail, and applied existing stripPrivateMemory privacy projection to memo payloads in both DeliberativeMeetingDetail and gate-panel Memos while preserving recommendation display, draft/published memo state, and publish receipt behavior.
changes.src/management/components/case-file/Case: Included existing caseFile.title ('決策卷宗' / 'Decision case file') on top-level unavailable case-file views alongside caseFile.unavailable ('無法讀取' / 'Unavailable') and the recorded reason code (or caseFile.reasonNotRecorded fallback '未記錄原因').
changes.src/agora/pages/learning/CommitteePage.t: Added focused tests verifying: (1) a natural deliberative meeting memo (mtg-0f7fa4993625ca47 / mem-859108aab82a9ef57033) displays the exact recorded unavailable reason (no_case_file_recorded) and existing zh-TW strings (決策卷宗, 無法讀取); (2) a deliberative memo with a valid case-file fixture renders groups, excerpts, sources, retrieval mode, empty-group reason, unresolved citation marker, rejected contribution reason, and focuses the cited item on citation click; (3) private memory items on deliberative and gate-panel memos are stripped while private_items_withheld badges and gate-panel draft->published memo state behavior remain intact.

acceptance_mapping.1: Bound the existing CaseFileViewPanel to natural deliberative meeting memos in CommitteePage.tsx using the existing GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/{id}/memos data (memo.case_file_view) and existing zh-TW caseFile strings (決策卷宗, 無法讀取, 未記錄原因).
acceptance_mapping.2: Verified in CommitteePage.test.tsx that a natural deliberative memo displays the exact recorded unavailable reason (no_case_file_recorded), that a valid case-file fixture renders excerpts, sources, retrieval mode, and citation focus, and that gate-panel memo rendering, privacy projection (stripPrivateMemory + private_items_withheld), and memo publish state behavior are preserved.
acceptance_mapping.3: Focused tests pass locally and read-only hosted browser steps on the exact FE/BFF pair are documented below. End-to-end acceptance on FE-DECISION-CASE-FILE-VIEWS-20261113 retains the requirement for real positive case-file content when an actual record with status='ok' is available on hosted dev.

hosted_browser_acceptance_steps_for_coor: 1. Pre-check exact FE/BFF pair: Query https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/deployment.json and https://api.dev.mvl-cap.tw/bff/version before and after the browser session. Confirm deploymentState is accepted/healthy and frontendSha includes this execute-plans merge commit paired with the deployed Pantheon dev BFF.
2. Authenticate read-only Dev browser session: Use the existing short-lived OPERATOR_A Dev login scoped to tenant-dev (verify GET /bff/me returns 200 and block all non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests).
3. Open Agora Committee page: Navigate to https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/agora/committee in Chromium (locale zh-TW) and wait for GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions (200) to render the session list.

4. Inspect natural deliberative meeting memo case-file state: Click a natural deliberative meeting row with recorded memos (e.g. data-testid='committee-session-mtg-0f7fa4993625ca47') and wait for GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions/mtg-0f7fa4993625ca47/memos (200). Locate data-testid='dissent-memo-mem-859108aab82a9ef57033' (and 'dissent-memo-mem-9f855b503b53a654b2d5').

5. Verify recorded unavailable reason or positive case-file content: When the BFF memo payload has case_file_view.status === 'unavailable' (e.g. reason 'no_case_file_recorded'), confirm data-testid='memo-mem-859108aab82a9ef57033-case-file-unavailable' is visible inside the memo row, shows '決策卷宗 · 無法讀取', and data-testid='memo-mem-859108aab82a9ef57033-case-file-unavailable-reason' displays '(no_case_file_recorded)'. When an actual memo record with case_file_view.status === 'ok' is available on hosted dev (required for full FE-DECISION-CASE-FILE-VIEWS-20261113 end-to-end closure), confirm data-testid='memo-<memo_id>-case-file' renders the case-file groups, excerpts, source owner/id, retrieval mode, and claim citation focus links.
